Business Questions & Strategic Answers.1. What drives returns?: Returns are primarily driven by low customer satisfaction scores (Customer_Rating < 3.5), deep discounting (Discount_pct >= 20%), and extended delivery transit times (Delivery_Days > 5). When delayed shipping coincides with aggressive discounts, return likelihood exceeds 44%.
Business Questions & Strategic Answers.2. How important is discounting?: Discounting is among the top 3 most predictive factors. Orders receiving >=20% discount experience a 44.1% return rate compared to only 12.1% for items with <=10% discount. Heavy discounts induce impulsive purchases with higher buyer remorse.
Business Questions & Strategic Answers.3. How important is delivery delay?: Fulfillment latency is a critical operational determinant. Deliveries taking more than 5 days exhibit a 41.2% return rate (vs. 23.1% for standard deliveries under 5 days). Customer rating degrades inversely with delivery duration, compounding return risk.
Business Questions & Strategic Answers.4. Which categories contribute most to r: Fashion and Electronics contribute the highest return volume and margin risk. Fashion suffers from sizing/expectation variance, while Electronics suffer return penalties when delayed.
Business Questions & Strategic Answers.5. Which regions contribute most to risk: South region exhibits the highest operational risk profile. While it generates substantial sales volume, it couples aggressive regional discounting with slower average fulfillment, resulting in the lowest net margins.
